about_the_game:
"just a dream" is a realistic first-person walking simulator in the style of a body-cam, presenting a psychological horror experience based on the aesthetics of liminal spaces. The game provides a unique experience of exploring nonlinear liminal spaces.

Your only goal is to find a way out of this place, venturing deeper and deeper into the dark depths of Poolrooms.

Game Features
  • Unique liminal spaces Poolrooms
  • Magnificent graphical style based on the Unreal Engine 5 game engine
  • Terrifying atmosphere of lostness and loneliness
